reviews.title: Undelivered paid content
reviews.text: I’ve used app for years (they have one astrologer, Patrick that is really good and accurate), and few days ago I’ve seen offer -40% for natal chart. I’ve paid and they’ve sent me some mail with “link” , but the link wasn’t doing anything or leading to any content. I’ve wrote to support and after dragging with two operators for three days (where they offered all sort of lies like my app isn’t up to date, so “glitch happened”), they simply stated they can not give me my previously paid content and they are offering some exchange, that has nothing to do with the birth chart . I wasn’t interested in any of these offered contents and I wanted just the chart I’ve paid for, which they declined. After years of purchasing readings and reports they simply scam you like that. Not anymore.

reviews.title: This app is a scam
reviews.text:
There is subscription scam. There is no way to cancel it.

I paid a small amount (around $1) for a personalized reading. The purchase was supposed to be a one-time thing, but a few days later, I was surprised to find a much larger charge on my account – about $39 USD.

What’s even more concerning is that there was no clear indication during the purchase that this would be a recurring payment. I went back to the app to try and cancel any possible subscription, but there doesn’t seem to be any option available. The “My Plan” section just keeps loading, and customer support hasn’t responded.
reviews.reply:
Hi [Name],

Thank you for sharing your feedback, and we are truly sorry to hear about your frustrating experience. We completely understand how upsetting it is to see an unexpected charge on your account and to face difficulties when trying to cancel or get in touch with support.

We want to help you resolve this immediately and ensure any recurring access is fully stopped. Please contact us directly at support-appstore@asknebula.com with your account details. A dedicated member of our team will look up your history, help you cancel everything successfully, and address your concerns regarding the charges.

Holding space for your journey,
Nebula

reviews.title: The app is a hoax!
reviews.text:
Do not use this app!!! They tell you you have a free premium account for life (I have their email to confirm that) and then suddenly start charging you for stuff you never signed up for, on a weekly basis.
There is no way to cancel the subscription from the app or through iPhone settings, and the charges just keep coming.
The customer support is completely non-responsive to all of this!

UPDATE: customer support answers my review by saying that I should contact customer support. Funny thing is, I DID THAT ALREADY TWICE before even writing the review. STILL NO ANSWER. So thank you for confirming the app is a hoax.

Best wishes, Nebula team
